title: Evaluation of Intracranial Pressure and Cerebral Blood Flow Dynamics during Surgery in Trendelenburg position
summary: Während Operationen in Kopftieflage (Trendelenburg Lagerung) erfolgt ein nichtinvasives Monitoring  des intrakraniellen Drucks, sowie eine Berechnung der zerebralen Autoregulation über eine NIRS-Messung und eine transkranielle Dopplermessung der Art. cerebri media. Die Daten werden postoperativ ausgewertet. Es handelt sich um eine reine Beobachtungsstudie ohne Intervention. Postoperativ werden die Patienten auf das Auftreten eines Delirs oder neurokognitive Einschränkungen hin untersucht.
conditions: Delirium not superimposed on dementia, so described

interventions.name: The study group consists of patients undergoing surgery in the Trendelenburg position. Intraoperatively the invasively measured blood pressure, the flow velocity of the middle cerebral artery (transcranial Doppler measurement) and  NIRS measurement are recorded. The control group consists of patients undergoing surgeries that are not performed in the Trendelenburg position. The same measurements are taken as in the control group, except for the 1-2 measurements of the optic nerve sheath in the head-down position.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
age > 18 years; ASA I -IV; surgery with general anaesthesia or combined anaesthesia; indikation for intraoperative measurement of cerebral blood flow; hemodynamic monitoring by means of arterial blood pressure measurement; written consent
Exclusion criteria:
Emergency operation; pregnancy; preoperative hemodynamic instability; deseases of the central nervous system; no written consent
